The major question in Brazil…

At exactly 5pm, a code is supposed to be entered that closes and locks the voting machines. Once a machine is locked, it can’t accept any more votes. It’s irreversible.

The Supreme Court extension was relayed a few minutes after polls were supposed to be closed and machines locked.

So… which machines were kept open? In what districts were those machines? And why weren’t they locked at 5pm?
